record.title: Tabler
record.description: Bootstrap 5 admin kit with 90+ pages: dashboards, components, forms, tables, charts, maps, auth and error screens, light and dark themes.

license.notes: Pinned to tag v1.0.0-beta20, the last release that commits the built demo/. Bundles ApexCharts 3.40.0 (MIT) and TinyMCE 6.4.2 (MIT). Unreferenced dark/full email previews are not stored.

record.author: The Tabler Authors
